background: Micah Wyatt is the Fremont County attorney and was elected in the November 2026 general election. The official county biography states that he assumed office on April 15, 2025, that he is a Wyoming native, and that he is a graduate of the University of Wyoming College of Arts and the University of Wyoming College of Law. He was unopposed in the 2026 primary and general elections.
